method.title: 方法
method.body: 设 $f(x)=P(x)/Q(x)$，其中 $P,Q$ 为多项式，$Q$ 不为零多项式；逐个排除 $Q(x)=0$。

pitfalls: 约分不能恢复原来没有定义的输入。

questions.prompt: 为什么相机镜头需要移动，才能对更近或更远的物体对焦？

steps.title: 示意模型
steps.body: 示意模型：薄透镜关系 $1/f=1/u+1/v$ 给出 $v=fu/(u-f)$，其中 $f$ 固定，$u>f$；物距 $u$ 改变时像距 $v$ 也改变。教材未给数值，此式用于说明有理关系。

questions.answer: 像距随物距变化，因此镜头需移动以使清晰图像落在成像面上。

en.prompt: Why does the lens on a camera need to move to focus on objects that are nearer or farther away?

steps.title: Illustrative model
steps.body: Illustrative model: the thin-lens relation $1/f=1/u+1/v$ gives $v=fu/(u-f)$ for fixed $f$ and $u>f$. Changing object distance $u$ changes image distance $v$. No numerical data are supplied; this illustrates the rational relationship.

en.answer: Image distance changes with object distance, so the lens position must change to focus the image on the imaging surface.
en.label: Opening question: camera

questions.label: 对焦问题

questions.prompt: 飞机的飞行时间与所处风的速度有什么关系？

steps.title: 示意模型
steps.body: 示意模型：航程 $d$、静风空速 $v$ 固定，沿航向风速为 $w$，顺风时间 $t=d/(v+w)$，逆风时间 $t=d/(v-w)$；相应地速必须为正。

questions.answer: 顺风通常缩短时间，逆风延长时间；分母体现地速限制。

en.prompt: What is the relationship between the travel time for a plane and the velocity of the wind in which it is flying?

steps.title: Illustrative model
steps.body: Illustrative model: for fixed distance $d$ and airspeed $v$, a wind component $w$ gives downwind time $t=d/(v+w)$ and upwind time $t=d/(v-w)$. The relevant ground speed must be positive.

en.answer: A tailwind shortens travel time and a headwind lengthens it; the denominator records the ground-speed restriction.
en.label: Opening question: wind

questions.label: 风速问题

questions.prompt: 如何把光源发出的光照量与离光源的距离联系起来？

steps.title: 示意模型
steps.body: 示意模型：理想点光源在固定条件下的照度可写成 $I=k/r^2$，$r>0$。距离加倍时 $I(2r)=I(r)/4$。

questions.answer: 理想模型中照度与距离平方成反比。

en.prompt: How can you relate the amount of light from a source to the distance from the source?

steps.title: Illustrative model
steps.body: Illustrative model: under fixed conditions an ideal point source gives illumination $I=k/r^2$, $r>0$. Doubling distance gives $I(2r)=I(r)/4$.

en.answer: In this idealized model, illumination varies inversely with the square of distance.
en.label: Opening question: light

questions.label: 光照问题

questions.prompt: 你已经见过有理数和有理式，那么什么是有理函数？

steps.title: 定义
steps.body: 定义：令 $P(x),Q(x)$ 为多项式，$Q$ 不为零多项式，则 $f(x)=P(x)/Q(x)$ 是有理函数；原式中 $Q(x)=0$ 的输入排除。

questions.answer: 例如 $1/x$，定义域为所有非零实数。

en.prompt: You have used the term rational before with rational numbers and rational expressions, so what is a rational function?

steps.title: Definition
steps.body: Definition: with polynomials $P(x),Q(x)$ and nonzero polynomial $Q$, $f(x)=P(x)/Q(x)$ is rational; exclude inputs for which the original $Q(x)=0$.

en.answer: For example, $1/x$ has all nonzero real numbers as its domain.
en.label: Opening question: definition
